Recorded claim:
Alarm notifications and iTIP Details converge on `openEventDialogForViewing`. Its second argument is a DOM `Event`; `openEventDialogForViewing(item, true)` was invalid. The legacy summary-dialog branch ignores it, while the new `CalendarDialog` uses it only to locate a positioning trigger. [Task 1]
